name: Windsurf
freeTierNote: Light agent quota and limited models (renamed Devin Desktop by Cognition in Jun 2026).

pricingTiers.name: Pro
pricingTiers.note: $20/mo monthly (no annual price shown; via Devin pricing)

priceBand: Free tier; Pro $20/mo via Devin pricing (Nov 2026)
bestFor: Trying an AI IDE with a usable free tier, or prototyping in a VS Code-like app
skipIf: You need a vendor story that has been stable for years
limitations: 2026 ownership transition to Cognition leaves roadmap stability in flux
summary: An AI IDE with a generous trial posture. Ownership moved to Cognition in 2026, so treat the roadmap as in motion.
body: Windsurf (renamed Devin Desktop by Cognition in June 2026, with windsurf.com redirecting to devin.ai) is the IDE you evaluate for its free agent quota before paying $20/mo for Pro. The risk is vendor continuity during the transition, not the autocomplete. If your procurement team asks who owns the binary next year, say that out loud before migrating an agency.
notes: Ask about data retention like you would any new IDE
Do not build a tutorial empire on a tool in an ownership transition without dating the article
